Something on the magnitude of at least eight kilometers in length.|Nasdra Magrody|Twelve.|Bunt Dantor|Seventeen.|attr=A Republic panel of experts debates the technical details of the ''Malevolence''|audio=Excerpt-02-SWholonetnews01-20081002.flac|src={{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}}} The '''''Malevolence''''' was a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The massive ship was longer than four [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and sported massive [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], capable of disabling enemy ships, mounted on both sides of its hull. The ship was first [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|spotted]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]] and [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]], who were on an inspection in the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]]. Grievous took the opportunity to fire the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] on Nune's fleet, destroying it. [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] led a fleet to engage the ''Malevolence'' after losing contact with Nune. After [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|destroying]] Koon's fleet, the ''Malevolence'' was revealed to the Republic after Koon was rescued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Dooku assigned the ''Malevolence'' to a major [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical center]] near the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]]. En route to the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center, the ''Malevolence'' [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|destroyed]] a Republic medical convoy passing through the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]]. Before the warship could attack the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], however, a [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|group]] of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] led by General Skywalker [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|intercepted]] the massive ship near the medcenter and disabled its ion cannons and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] with proton torpedoes. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was taken hostage aboard the ''Malevolence'', and Skywalker and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] left to rescue Amidala. Prior to escaping the [[Warship/Legends|warship]], Skywalker tampered with the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]]. Grievous fled on his [[Soulless One/Legends|starfighter]] after noting that the battle had been lost. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stationed on the ''Malevolence'' believed that the hyperdrive had been fixed; however, the sabotaged navicomputer caused the ''Malevolence'' to crash into the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]]. ==Description== {{Quote|Our ship is unstoppable.|Grievous|}} The Malevolence was a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]]. It was 4,845 meters long and had two twin [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]]. Once the cannons were fired, the wave from the cannons would expand over distances and disable any ship when the wave impacted in one. After the ion cannons disabled a ship, approximately 500 [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] fired and completely destroyed the enemy [[warship]]. The vessel's power plant operated by recapturing waste heat and propulsion by-products. The design required a gigantic hull and had to vent its stored energy regularly, which was adopted to the ion cannons.''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' A panel of experts debated the warship's size on the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], as many predicted how big the ship was. The massive ship had an internal [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jet]] system, which served as a [[Hovertrain/Legends|Hovertrain]] that transported, troops, ammunition, supplies throughout the ship. The cars looked similar to the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTT]].{{SWArchive|url=video/view/000807.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Decoded Episode: Rising ''Malevolence''|nobackup=1}} The ship's computer systems were built with parts from [[KynachTech Industries]].''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]'' Equipped with sixteen gigantic [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]], the ''Malevolence'' also had a powerful [[hyperdrive]], and at one point, [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was told that the ''Malevolence'' was fast enough to outrun any [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces. The ship carried two [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]] that could pul any [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] or small vessel aboard the ''Malevolence''. Which were used during the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]]. Complementing the ship, [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] were on board to fight any enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]].{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} At least one [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]], nicknamed a "pod hunter" was aboard the ''Malevolence'', and was often deployed with [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] to seek and eliminate enemy escape pods, to leave no witnesses. The ''Malevolence'' also held Grievous' [[Soulless One/Legends|personal starfighter]]. ==History== ===Rise of the ''Malevolence''=== {{Quote|Until found this menace is, vigilant we all must be.|Yoda commenting on the ''Malevolence''|''[[The Clone Wars: Shakedown]]''}} [[File:Malevolence_tower.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Malevolence''{{'s}} command tower.]] *The Malevolence was designed by [[Ruggle Schmong/Legends|Ruggle Schmong]]{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''|d=y}} and built by [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Separatists on [[Pammant]]. It was the first of its class,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' the Separatists got it after [[SoroSuub Corporation]] rejected the ship. The vessel was constructed in a giant [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]] that Republic Spies couldn't penetrate. When the Malevolence was launched, the spies were captured. Count Dooku, named the Malevolence meaning "wishing evil to others." It served as General Grievous' [[flagship]] before to his use of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|Invisible Hand]] and destroyed many of the Republic's task forces, including the [[Fourth Fleet/Legends|Galactic Republic Fourth Fleet]].''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' It was known that the Malevolence had at least a sister ship, the [[Devastation]].{{SWArchive|url=games/videogames/news20081113.html|text=Fun Facts about ''Star Wars The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance''}} The giant ''Malevolence'' was first found by [[Jedi General/Legends]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]] and [[Clone Commander]] [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]] as they with 3 [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Cruisers]] went to the [[Phu system/Legends]] for an inspection. The owner, General Grievous took the opportunity to shoot at the Republic forces; The first wave from the cannon destroyed the shields of the [[Laudable]]. Nune and Kite tried to evacuate their ship, because the ship was already doomed because of the incredible amount of firepower the ''Malevolence'' had. After the [[Jedi Order]] knew about the Malevolence, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] volunteered to take 3 cruisers to find and destroy the "mysterious weapon", as the ''Malevolence'' had been called.''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]'' Aboard the ''Venator''-class cruiser [[Triumphant/Legends|Triumphant]]. Koon tracked the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]] ===Battle of Abregado=== {{Quote|Finding it is one thing. Finding a way to stop it is another.|Mace Windu|}} When Koon tracked the massive ''Malevolence'' in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], he intended to report as much information as possible on the weapon in case of his defeat. After the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], arrived aboard the ''Malevolence'' to watch General Grievous' progress, he ordered the general to jam the Republic task force's transmissions. Koon and [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]] reported information to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. However, the nearby ''Malevolence'' cut their communications.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}} [[File:Battle_of_Abregado.jpg|thumb|right|230px|The ''Malevolence'' engaging Koon's fleet]] While the ''Malevolence'' was out of firing range of the advancing Republic fleet, Grievous nevertheless ordered the battle droids to fire its ion cannon, which passed over the fleet and neutralized the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]' shields. As the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|battle]] continued, the intense fire from the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} numerous turbolaser [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] soon engulfed the vulnerable Republic Star Destroyers. After Koon and several clones jettisoned their fleet in escape pods, Dooku ordered the battle droids to deploy the "pod hunters" to track down and eliminate the survivors. Using the last known report from Koon, Skywalker and Tano emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in Skywalker's commandeered freighter, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], to look for Koon. Both Jedi noticed the large debris field the battle had produced. The pod hunters had destroyed all but Koon's pod, but Koon and his clone troopers destroyed those battle droids. Skywalker and Tano rescued Koon and the surviving clones, after which the ''Twilight'' detected the approaching ''Malevolence'', and Koon ordered Skywalker to shut down all of the freighter's systems. However, the group left a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] active, and the ''Malevolence'' detected the ''Twilight''. Koon, Skywalker, and Tano reactivated their ship and fled the area. Grievous ordered the ion cannon to be fired, but failed to stop the Jedi before they entered hyperspace. Thus the Republic learned of the warship and its ion cannons, and despite most of Koon's forces being eradicated, Dooku considered the battle a defeat. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was most displeased with Grievous' failure to prevent the Republic from learning of the warship. His trust in Grievous shaken, Dooku left to discuss plans with [[Palpatine/Legends|his Sith master]]. ===Ryndellia conflict=== {{Quote|Boy, this is a lot more fun when they're not shooting back.''"
"''I still can't seem to hit anything.|Two battle droids during the battle|}} {{Main|Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends}} In the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]], the ''Malevolence'' intercepted several Republic [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] that were passing through the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. A ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer that was escorting the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] tried to protect the medical convoys; however, Grievous attacked the Republic medical convoy with the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} numerous laser cannons. After the ''Malevolence'' destroyed the small fleet, one of the frigates evaded the fire and began to escape. Grievous ordered the ship's ion cannons to be fired at the fleeing frigate. The electrical ion surge decimated the frigate's power, and the ''Malevolence'' then directed heavy fire at the frigate, destroying it. Count Dooku, who had been watching Grievous' progress through a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] transmission, told the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general of the Republic's [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], treating over 60,000 wounded clones near the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. Dooku assigned the medical center as the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} new target. Grievous was pleased with this new assignment, as it showed that the Count had not lost all faith in him since the defeat at Abregado. ===Destruction of the ''Malevolence''=== {{Dialogue|Yularen|Skywalker! The enemy warship has attacked our convoy of medical transports near Ryndellia.|Tano|Medical transports? Only General Grievous would go after clones who can't fight back.|Skywalker|The Ryndellia system… Near Naboo? Isn't that where our medical base is? I bet that will be his next target.|attr=Admiral Wullf Yularen, Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker|audio=RyndelliaSystem-SoM.flac|src=}} {{Main|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends}} [[File:Battle_of_Kaliida.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The ''Malevolence'' under attack by [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], led by Anakin Skywalker]] En route to the medical facility, Dooku contacted Grievous through a hologram transmission, after he received intelligence from his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], that the Republic had launched a small group of fighters to attack the ''Malevolence''. Grievous noted that the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} hyperdrive was not fast and the warship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] was forced to recalculate its coordinates in order to go around the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]. In an attempt to stop him, Skywalker and Tano retrieved brand-new [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]], nimble [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] manufactured by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]].''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]'' Their [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|squadron]] soon left and entered the Kaliida Nebula as a [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] to arrive at the medcenter before the ''Malevolence'', while [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his fleet went around the nebula. The massive ship arrived near the medcenter and began to fire on the departing medical frigates. Upon emerging from the nebula, Skywalker led the Republic [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to engage the ''Malevolence''. Vulture droids were dispatched from the ''Malevolence'' and attacked the Republic group. As they engaged Skywalker's bombers, Grievous ordered the battle droids to fire the ion cannon at the approaching group. The ion wave deactivated the Vulture droids and three of Skywalker's bombers. However, the Republic squadron managed to damage the two heavy ion cannons, causing them to overload and explode and damaging the ship's hyperdrive in the process. After the Republic disabled the ''Malevolence'', Count Dooku contacted Grievous and informed him that his master had sent a senator to the warship's location. Sidious, using his alter ego of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, sent [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who were to negotiate a peace treaty with [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] officials. However, Amidala wasn't fully aware of the situation, and she and her droid were captured by the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], but evaded capture after destroying their [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|ship]] inside the warship's hangar. [[Firefighter droid/Legends|Firefighting battle droids]] that were stationed aboard rushed to the scene of the destroyed ship and began to extinguish the flames. Skywalker and Kenobi planned a rescue and left on the ''Twilight'' to board the ''Malevolence'' through an emergency airlock. Grievous and a squad of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] soon left the bridge while Amidala contacted Skywalker via a transmission box inside the ''Malevolence''. The senator waited until Grievous and his entourage passed by her before entering the internal rail jet room. Noticing that there were intruders, Grievous ordered the battle droids to protect the internal systems of the massive warship and to fix the hyperdrive. [[File:MalevolenceDoomed-DM.png|thumb|right|230px|The ''Malevolence'' in flames shortly before its destruction]] Inside the internal rail jet room, battle droids began to attack Amidala and C-3PO. Skywalker and Kenobi met up with Amidala inside the room, and Skywalker rescued Amidala on a separate rail cart while Kenobi went to rescue her droid, C-3PO. After Kenobi Force-pushed C-3PO onto storage containers outside the jet railings, Kenobi entered the hyperdrive room. Grievous confronted Kenobi, though the Jedi Master escaped to the rail jet room. Unbeknownst to Grievous, Skywalker and Amidala entered the bridge and destroyed all stationed battle droids there. As Amidala hid the destroyed battle droids inside a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]], Skywalker tampered with the warship's navicomputer before the two left. Grievous followed Kenobi and engaged the Jedi in a lightsaber duel, but Kenobi escaped again and met up with Skywalker, Amidala, C-3PO and R2 in the ''Twilight''. Seeing that the battle had been lost, Grievous left the ''Malevolence'' in his personal starfighter, the ''[[Soulless One]]''. Meanwhile, the droid crew aboard the ''Malevolence'', believing the hyperdrive to be fixed, prepared to jump to [[Sector Four (Confederacy)/Legends|Sector Four]] in Confederate space. However, the droids, who were destroyed by Skywalker and Amidala, did not contact the squad of B1 battle droids that were preparing to jump to hyperspace. The battle droids realized that the massive warship wasn't responding to the coordinates they entered and contacted Grievous and was instead heading into the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]]. The general frantically ordered the droids to reset the navicomputer, but they failed to do so, resulting in the destruction of the ship as it crashed into the moon. Grievous managed to escape, and the ''Twilight'' returned to the waiting Republic ships. The ''Malevolence''{{'s}} threat was over. After the vessel's destruction, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]] was assigned to investigate the wreckage. [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker]] found computer parts which originated from [[Kynachi]]. The squad was later assigned to [[Mission to Kynachi|investigate]] Kynachi. ===Rebuilding of the ''Malevolence''=== Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ''Malevolence'' was [[Malevolence (II)|rebuilt]] at [[Pammant Docks/Legends|Pammant Docks]]. Before it ever left the docks, however, this successor vessel was [[Mission to Pammant|destroyed]] by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]]. ==Commanders and crew== {{Quote|Do not compound your failure this day by allowing our prized warship to fall.|Count Dooku, to Grievous|}} [[File:Rising_Malevolence.png|thumb|left|200px|General Grievous and Count Dooku on the ''Malevolence'' bridge]] General Grievous was the leading commander of the ''Malevolence'', and it served as his flagship. Battle droids maintained and controlled the bridge. Grievous commanded the battle droids; however, the relationship between Grievous and battle droids was shaken during his time commanding the ''Malevolence''. Count Dooku was on board at the time of the Battle of Abregado and acted as an advisor for Grievous. The Sith Lord also served as another commander, and often contacted Grievous via hologram to check in on the general's progress. He helped Grievous by orchestrating battle plans, as well as exploiting the maneuvers and attacks of the Republic forces. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Malevolence'' was originally based on concept art for a Separatist [[communications ship]] meant to be used in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Designed in [[2004]], the warship was originally Grievous' flagship during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], with a design similar to that of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. The idea of the massive warship was dropped, and the ''Invisible Hand'' became Grievous' flagship in ''Revenge of the Sith''.{{InsiderCite|issue1=83|issue2=85|The Art of Revenge of the Sith|The Art of ''Revenge of the Sith''}} According to [[Dave Filoni]], supervising director of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', the ''Malevolence'' and its story were based in part on the real-life German battleship [[Wikipedia:German battleship Bismarck|''Bismarck'']], which the British [[Wikipedia:Royal Navy|Royal Navy]] hunted relentlessly during World War II.{{SW|url=video/shadow-of-malevolence-episode-featurette|text="Shadow of Malevolence" Episode Featurette}} The finished version of the ''Malevolence'' was designed by [[Russell G. Chong]] and was based upon the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]]. Originally, the iconic train-like transport system in the center of the ''Malevolence'' was created so large that the ''Malevolence'', to scale, could be flown inside its own train system. [[File:Malevolence_early_concept.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Early ''Malevolence'' concept art]] In the ''The Clone Wars'' episode "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," Anakin Skywalker commands the Y-wing bombers to attack the starboard ion cannon, but the port cannon is the one destroyed. Anakin may have meant the cannon on the '''bombers''' starboard side. The explosion takes out both cannons, however. It is possible that the cannons either use the same power generator or are really just one big two-way cannon that can fire from either side; this may have caused the destruction of one side to produce a chain reaction destroying both guns, as well as causing extensive damage to most of the ship. [[Henry Gilroy]] has suggested that the reason the ''Malevolence'' is able to receive holographic communications while in hyperspace is related to the size of the ship's internal gravity field.{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?t=14536&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=61|thread=The Clone Wars TV SHOW on Cartoon Network: WOWOWOW|user=HGilroy|date=2008-10-10|time=9:48 pm}} The firing-channel design of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion cannon is almost identical to the firing channel of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
